title: CDFD Part I: Fundamental Physics - Constraint-Driven Field Theory and Flux Dynamics
description: Public Part I physics archive for Constraint-Driven Field Theory / Constraint-Driven Flux Dynamics (release v1.1.0, 2026-08-25). Twelve article-class manuscripts with supplementary scripts, interactive panels, bibliography, claim-status and correction-status ledgers, and a minimal public demo. Named capacity, operating-ratio, vacuum-memory, and Mujjabi-test constructs are postulated CDFT notation and falsifiable targets—not established physical laws. Open preprint; not peer reviewed. Separate from the AGPL CDFD Runtime.
